task.title: Delete a service account
task.shortdesc: You can delete a service account. You must be the owner of a service account if you want to reset it or delete it. The Organization Administrator user can reset or delete any service account.

ul.li: Ensure you are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.

step.cmd: From the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, Click the settings icon (⚙) and click Service Accounts.
Identify the service account you want to delete and click the options icon (⋮).
Verify that you want to delete this account and click Delete service account.
